reviewKind: AI author review and independent AI checks
scope: Original authored Bokmål development curriculum; grammatical facts checked against official sources. Dictionary definitions and examples were not imported. Listening collections preserve their authored source records.

wordWorld.aiAuthorReview: all 600 sentence translations and all contextual token hints
wordWorld.independentAIReview: Root read all 120 L1 and all 120 L3 bilingual pairs; targeted L2 spot checks. Full second independent review of all L2/token hints is not claimed.

postDraftCorrection.change: Use valid English spelling cafe instead of café to satisfy the unchanged English-authority character policy. Listening English text was kept aligned.

verbs.review: AI author review of lexical meanings; official dictionary verb/infinitive facts verified. No sentence exercises in this bank.

nouns.review: All noun gender possibilities checked with official dictionary facts; homographs matched to the authored sense.

conjugation.review: All 480 displayed forms independently matched to exact active Inf/Pres/Past/PerfPart forms coexisting in one official lemma.

grammar.review: AI author and independent AI review of all320 examples; all exact slots/anchors and every round validated.
grammar.convention: Common/neuter agreement in phrases; meaning/form stages avoid false gender distractors. Three-gender noun mode accepts all authored alternatives.

remainingUncertainties: Native-speaker review of naturalness, child suitability, frequency and level placement remains outstanding.
Bokmål has multiple standard inflection choices; this course displays a conventional form, without claiming other valid spellings are wrong.
Device speech is unreviewed, dialect/voice availability depends on the device, and no authored IPA or pronunciation approval is claimed.
This is a complete playable expanded development course, not completion of the much larger long-term expansion targets or CEFR certification.
